info.name: Travel Assistant API
info.description: Runs against the API gateway (docker compose up --build). Covers the gateway's GraphQL API (accounts and profiles, backed by the REST user service), CRUD, filtering, validation errors, trips with flights, and the recommendation summary (business logic). Every request has tests; records it creates it deletes.

item.name: 5. Trip service (trips, flights, itineraries)
item.description: Eric's trip service through the gateway. Signs in as the seeded user alice@example.com, creates a trip and checks its day-by-day itinerary, then deletes it.

exec: pm.test('returns a token and the user', () => { pm.expect(body.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.user.email).to.eql('alice@example.com'); });

pm.test('returns the trips of the signed-in user only', () => { const list = Array.isArray(body) ? body : body.data; pm.expect(list).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; list.forEach((t) => pm.expect(t.ownerId).to.eql(1)); });
pm.test('trip belongs to the caller', () => pm.expect(body.ownerId).to.eql(1));

item.name: Attach flight 1 to the trip (details copied from the flight service)

exec: pm.test('flight details were copied from the flight service', () => { pm.expect(body.flightId).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.airline).to.eql('Alaska Airlines'); pm.expect(body.origin).to.eql('SEA'); pm.expect(body.price).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Location header points at the trip flight', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.eql(`/api/trips/${pm.collectionVariables.get('tripId')}/flights/${body.id}`));

item.name: 4. Recommendation summary (business logic)
item.description: POST /api/advice/recommendations: the LLM service calls the Flight, Hotel and Activity services, picks a package, adds up the cost in code and saves the summary.

exec: pm.test('Location header points at the saved advice', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.eql(`/api/advice/${body.id}`));
pm.test('total equals the sum of the breakdown (computed in code)', () => pm.expect(body.total).to.be.closeTo(body.breakdown.flights + body.breakdown.hotel + body.breakdown.activities, 0.01));
pm.test('within budget and remaining is budget minus total', () => { pm.expect(body.within_budget).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.remaining).to.be.closeTo(body.budget - body.total, 0.01); });
pm.test('summary is saved and mentions the total', () => pm.expect(body.summary).to.include('Total $'));

item.name: The recommendation was saved as advice
Tight budget: package is reported as over budget, not hidden

exec: pm.test('over budget is reported honestly', () => { pm.expect(body.within_budget).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.remaining).to.be.below(0); });

item.name: Prepare: a unique email for this run
AI assistant: a flight question returns the answer, the tool steps and the flights found

exec: pm.test('steps and flights are lists', () => { pm.expect(a.steps).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(a.flights).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('the model made at most 2 flight searches (the cap)', () => pm.expect(a.steps.filter((s) => s.tool === 'search_flights' && !/limit reached/.test(s.summary)).length).to.be.at.most(2));
pm.test('every flight shown is a real flight with an id and a price', () => a.flights.forEach((f) => { pm.expect(f.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(f.price).to.be.a('number'); }));
pm.test('stub mode uses no tools', () => { pm.expect(a.steps).to.have.lengthOf(0); pm.expect(a.flights).to.have.lengthOf(0); });
